decision_rationale: This is a primary method paper on protein sequence embeddings (SeqVec), with biology central and a new model introduced. The provided evidence treats proteins as sentences and amino acids as words, which is biological token modeling rather than a substantive natural-language text component.
evidence_snippet: “each protein was treated as a sentence and each amino acid was interpreted as a single word”; “We introduced a novel way to represent protein sequences as continuous vectors”
